newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle weak in light test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle weak in light test - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers weak in a light test, compared to Tuesday's close, USDA said.
Trade was slow and demand light to moderate. Seller interest moderate. Offerings current.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1175 lbs 68.00 Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1150 lbs few 67.00-68.00
Carcass Basis (weight only) compared to Tuesday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers were mostly $1.00 lower, instances 2.00 lower.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1250 lbs 2 ld 109.00
Holstein: (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400
